meta.title: SLATE research: hygiene products, usage and grooming
meta.method: Toiletry prices were read programmatically on 2026-10-01 from the same public endpoints as research-groceries.json: the Wynshop storefrontgateway preview search for Price Rite (store 301, Hamden CT by New Haven), The Fresh Grocer (Wakefern store 197, Brooklyn), Smart & Final (store 371, Los Angeles), SuperValu (store 5550) and Save-On-Foods (store 937, Vancouver); Giant Tiger's Shopify search API; and Chedraui's VTEX catalog search. Those rows have confirmed:true. Tesco and Sainsbury's rows come from Trolley.co.uk product pages (the store's own row in the price comparison), because the chains block automated reads; they have confirmed:false. Where a product was on promotion the regular price is recorded and the promotional price is in the note. sizeQty is net weight (g) or volume (ml) for consumables and the item count (ct) for toothbrushes, razors, toilet rolls, floss dispensers, pads and tampons; US ounces were converted at 28.3495 g/oz and 29.5735 ml/fl oz. Usage figures come from weighed-use studies (Loretz 2006/2008, Hall 2007, as tabulated by US EPA), the EU SCCS Notes of Guidance, ADA and CDC guidance, YouGov surveys and manufacturer statements, each with its source. Grooming prices were gathered by three research agents from each business's own website or own booking page; their confirmed flag means the price was read on the business's own page on 2026-10-01.
meta.taxIncluded: true for GB, IE and MX, where shelf prices include VAT/IVA; false for US and CA, where sales tax is added at the till. No tax rates are asserted.
gaps: Price Rite (store 301) returned no dental floss for any search.

Sheets per roll are stated only for Price Rite (Paperbird 1,000 1-ply; Charmin Essentials 330) and Smart & Final (Simply Value 264). No other chain states sheet counts; SuperValu gives total m2 instead.
Tesco has no own-label toothbrush, razor, shaving foam or floss on Trolley, so branded items are used; Sainsbury's deodorant is branded (Sure). All GB rows are confirmed:false.

Usage: no weighed bar-soap-per-shower study was found (only a 1983 industry average of 2.6 g per bath-soap application); there are no shower or hair-washing surveys for Canada, Ireland or Mexico; toilet paper per day is a Charmin figure (57 sheets) with no first-hand UK/IE/CA/MX equivalent; disposable-razor shave counts are manufacturer claims seen only in retailer listings, so only the Gillette Mach3 cartridge (15 shaves) is recorded; floss length per use was not found.
Hair growth: the AAD page fetched did not state a rate, so the 1/2 inch a month figure rests on Cleveland Clinic (4-6 inches a year) and is recorded as such.

Grooming: no Supercuts prices for New York (its site is script-only; aggregator figures were not used); no chain branch inside New Haven (Great Clips row is in Milford); Chris McMillan is in Beverly Hills; Canadian chains (First Choice, Magicuts, Great Clips) publish no branch prices, so QB House stands in for Toronto and Vancouver has no chain entry; London budget barber Zino may be stale; Brown Sugar, Dylan Bradshaw and Toni&Guy Ireland were dropped because prices could not be read; durations are mostly null except where Fresha/Square/Booksy or the menu gives them; some menus give a single haircut price (slug "haircut").
